load.definition: Nearest-rank p50/p95 of complete SDK call_tool round trips, excluding client initialization and queue wait. Warm HTTP connection pool; no warmup calls removed. One-hotel feeds, two-hotel comparison, audit n=10, BM25, cached market only, ADR baseline without market calibration. hold_offer measures confirm=false refusals/throttle; no holds are created. Error latencies are included and error counts are explicit. Local results are not deployment latency or throughput guarantees.
